overview.name: appyradar-sentinal
overview.tagline: Fleet telemetry for the AppyDave machine network
overview.what: An always-on headless process that SSHes into every machine in the fleet from a single orchestrator, collects telemetry, writes a snapshot file, and exposes the data via MCP for Claude and other agents to query.
overview.why: Five machines, zero dashboards. Understanding what's running, what's broken, and what's drifting requires either SSHing into each machine manually or having something do it for you. AppyRadar Sentinel does it for you.
key_facts: Zero remote footprint — no agent installed on target machines; all collection via SSH stdin pipe
7 SSH connections per machine (compound scripts, down from 12 naive calls)
Snapshot written atomically — readers always see a complete file
MCP server is read-only over the snapshot file — never touches live systems

architecture.description: Three-layer pipeline: bash scripts run on remote machines → parsers convert raw output to typed data → orchestrator assembles one MachineSnapshot per machine → snapshot-store writes to disk → MCP server exposes to agents

layers.name: SSH Transport
layers.role: Pipes bash scripts to remote machines via stdin. Returns empty string on any failure — callers detect silent failures by checking for empty.

layers.name: Bash Scripts
layers.role: Template functions that generate the bash scripts run on each machine. PATH-explicit (bun, tailscale, docker) to avoid missing-tool false negatives.

layers.name: Parsers
layers.role: Pure string → typed result. No SSH, no filesystem, no side effects. Every function handles null/undefined/empty input gracefully.

layers.name: Orchestrator
layers.role: collectMachine() wires all three layers for one machine. Returns a MachineSnapshot regardless of outcome — offline machines return status: offline.

layers.name: Snapshot Store
layers.role: Writes sentinel-latest.json and a dated archive atomically after every collection cycle.

layers.name: MCP Server
layers.role: Read-only layer over sentinel-latest.json. 7 tools. Never touches collectors or live systems.

configuration.note: Gitignored, per-deployment. Copy sentinel.config.example.json to get started.

collectors.name: Identity
collectors.captures: hostname, OS, arch, uptime, user, load averages

collectors.name: System / Memory
collectors.captures: RAM total, used, free, use%, memory pressure (from sysctl kern.memorystatus_vm_pressure_level)
collectors.notes: Pressure is 1=ok, 2=warning, 4=critical. Heuristic fallback for non-macOS.

collectors.name: Disk
collectors.captures: Per-volume: filesystem, total/used/avail GB, use%, mount, alert level

collectors.name: Tools
collectors.captures: Version strings for: ruby, node, bun, python3, ansible, git, brew, claude, tmux, docker, rbenv, ollama, tailscale. brew_outdated count.
collectors.notes: Tool list reflects AppyDave stack. Future: configurable tool list via config.

collectors.name: App Status
collectors.captures: Per registered app: path exists, port listening, display name, group, tier
collectors.notes: Data source: appsJsonPath in sentinel.config.json. Returns empty if file absent.

collectors.name: Skills & Claude
collectors.stage_label: Inline plugin — candidate for Skills Sentinel
collectors.captures: Global Claude skills, plugins, commands, claude version
collectors.notes: Future: Skills & Agents Sentinel. AppyRadar would consume its expose surface.

collectors.name: Brains
collectors.captures: Brain count, stale count, by-activity breakdown, per-brain metadata

collectors.name: Relay (Syncthing)
collectors.captures: Relay exists, syncthing running, folder list with file counts

collectors.name: OMI
collectors.stage_label: Ingest gesture — candidate for OMI Sentinel
collectors.captures: Total files, enriched, pending, newest/oldest, monthly breakdown, sample pending
collectors.notes: Known issue: mode and session_id return undefined — format mismatch in parser.

collectors.name: AngelEye
collectors.captures: Installed, running, session counts (total, active, 24h), top project, session types
collectors.notes: Current AngelEye is pre-sentinel. Once AngelEye becomes a proper sentinel, this inline collector is replaced by an MCP/REST client call to AngelEye's expose surface.

collectors.name: Git Repos
collectors.captures: Per repo: path, branch, dirty files, unpushed commits, last commit, remote
collectors.notes: skipGit: true in config skips this. Full scan takes ~3-5 min per machine.
